en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a river valley and town bordered by hills or low mountains. In the right foreground stands a large lion monument on a stone pedestal, with trees behind it. A promenade or lookout terrace with a railing runs along the edge, with several people walking and a young girl in traditional-style clothing standing near the left side. At the bottom, there is a printed caption in German.
